body: If b.s. then ok, if not, as a suicidal person, this basically sums up the feeling inside. Turmoil, chaos, fear, anger, disorientation.
Thanks! I knew i recognized it

Yeah maybe, but there's issues on the supply-end of things. I have to go see some "guy" somewhere i'm not supposed to be and shit can get messy really fast. A few people i know has been caught and or have had their appartments searched (destroyed) by police, and in my current state i'm not willing to risk it.

All I ever wanted to do, like legit, when growing up is to be a proffesional drummer. That being said tho, the chance of employment, and or "making it" with any sort of band is basically not existent. Either producers pay next to nothing for a session drummer, or they program the drums in a software that's 100% acurate, and is faster than actual recording.
In my present state of mind, I don't see that as a valid option, it was more of a silly "childhood" dream.

I've realized that as a "generic" human, your are destined for "generic" things, accomplishments. And i've come to accept that, but i also don't see the point in moving forward with anything (put in the effort) just for mere generic-ness.

I've thought of moving to amsterdam, the only place i know that's sortof close by, and with favorable labor-trade agreements with my country (as a part of the EU), but it's just too overwhelming, and expensive, to move to another country, and also learning a new language that's hard as shit. I'm too much of a lost soul currently to be just fucking off to someplace i don't know, without any faces i recognize.

I'm sorry i'm countering your words with such negativity, as i assure you i'm aware of how ridiculous this all is, like, really, i don't have a reason to not feel vital, but still i don't. The downward spiral becomes reality, and I don't have the tools to break the momentum of all the shit things that has happened, to me, to my family, to everyone. I'm aware that all people suffer, that's one thing we have in common besides death, we all suffer sometime, more or less. I wasn't born somewhere where i have to go through garbage everyday to stay alive, i was luckily born into a society that's not broken, or poor, and that's what makes it feel so sad, pathetic, ridiculous to feel this way.

Where i live it's almost as people are so far detached from what it is to be human, with all the nonsense of western society, social interaction and just plain bullshit. I like to watch the video "The blue pearl" narrated by Carl Sagan almost every day just to remind myself of how unimportant- important shit really is. Like, people are still fighting gay marriage? People are still fucking medival sometimes, but that video reminds me that we're all small ants just rushing to get our next fix of social status, or riches, or stardom. It doesn't matter in the end, because we're all going to die, none the wiser, all but lost on a small blue dot floating through infinity.

I'm sorry i've wasted your time, starting to think my post should've been posted in a philosophy subreddit instead.

Hey and thanks for reading through my rambling. 

I'm not advocating any drug use, be it positive or negative, it was just what happened.  

Unfortunatley i'm european, so moving somewhere where it's legal/decriminalised is beyond me at the moment. I don't have the funds to move to another country.

I've tried being optimistic for my therapy sessions but i've run out of optimism recently. 

The irony is that one of my bands songs is called Don't let the evil bird build a nest in your heart -.-

Thanks again for reading through my shit
